svg.title: One box, twelve threads: my homelab on a single mini PC
svg.desc: Circuit-board illustration. A central chip labelled Proxmox VE connects through glowing copper traces to Tailscale, AdGuard, Frigate, Beszel, Uptime Kuma, Coolify and Home Assistant. A row of twelve LEDs shows the CPU threads: eight amber on four performance cores, four cyan on efficiency cores.

g.text: My homelab on a single mini PC in Da Nang.
